# FDG2031

> AVOID mixing low-level and high-level APIs in a single namespace if the low-level APIs are very complex (i.e., they contain many types).

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 2.2.4.2 Exposing Layers in the Same Namespace.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: needs to know which types are low-level and which high-level.
